mapper.sql: T.ORDER_EXP_TYPE IS NOT NULL AND T.ORDER_EXP_TYPE <> ' ' AND T.ORDER_EXP_TYPE <> '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT T.ID, T.CARD_ID, T.TICKET_TRANS_SEQ, T.TOTAL_AMOUNT, T.IN_TIME, T.DEVICE_ID, T.OUT_TIME, T.ORDER_EXP_TYPE, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, T.TXN_DATE FROM GATE_TXN_PAY T WHERE AND
ORDER BY T.OUT_TIME, T.ID FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT T.TXN_DATE, T.OUT_STATION, T.DEVICE_ID, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, NVL(SUM(T.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS PAY_AMOUNT FROM GATE_TXN_PAY T WHERE AND T.DEBIT_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY T.TXN_DATE, T.OUT_STATION, T.DEVICE_ID, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE ORDER BY T.TXN_DATE, T.OUT_STATION, T.DEVICE_ID, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE

SELECT T.TXN_DATE, T.OUT_STATION, T.DEVICE_ID, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE, COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, NVL(SUM(T.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS PAY_AMOUNT FROM GATE_TXN_PAY T WHERE AND GROUP BY T.TXN_DATE, T.OUT_STATION, T.DEVICE_ID, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE ORDER BY T.TXN_DATE, T.OUT_STATION, T.DEVICE_ID, T.SIGN_CHANNEL_CODE

SELECT T.TXN_DATE, NVL(SUM(T.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS RECON_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(T.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS PAY_AMOUNT FROM GATE_TXN_PAY T WHERE AND T.DEBIT_STATUS = 'SUCCESS' GROUP BY T.TXN_DATE ORDER BY T.TXN_DATE

SELECT T.ID, T.TXN_DATE, T.CARD_ID, T.OUT_TIME, T.OVERTIME_AMOUNT, T.EXIT_STATION_NAME, T.DEVICE_ID FROM GATE_TXN_PAY T WHERE AND NVL(T.OVERTIME_AMOUNT, 0) > 0 AND T.CARD_TYPE IN ('0445', '0446', '0447', '0448')
ORDER BY T.OUT_TIME, T.ID FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
